name: Hellhounds

variantInfo.name: Hellhound
notes: Standard Hellhounds, found in various locations around Gielinor.
Only attack with melee bites.
Hellhound monster page marks them as demonic, so demonbane weapons work.
Level 122 and level 136 versions have a 50% water weakness.

variantInfo.name: Hellhound
notes: Stronger Hellhounds found only in the God Wars Dungeon.
Killing them contributes to Zamorak kill count.
God Wars Dungeon Hellhounds are aggressive unless wearing a Zamorak-affiliated item.

variantInfo.name: Hellhound
notes: Stronger Hellhounds found only in the Wilderness Slayer Cave.
Have access to the Wilderness Slayer Cave drop table.
Smouldering stone drop rate from these Hellhounds is increased by 50%.

variantInfo.name: Skeleton Hellhound (Vet'ion)
notes: Two are summoned midway through Vet'ion's first phase.
They must be defeated to continue the fight.
For more information on fighting Vet'ion, see Vet'ion/Strategies.

variantInfo.name: Greater Skeleton Hellhound (Vet'ion)
notes: Two are summoned midway through Vet'ion's second phase.
They must be defeated to continue the fight.
For more information on fighting Vet'ion, see Vet'ion/Strategies.

variantInfo.name: Skeleton Hellhound (Calvar'ion)
notes: Two are summoned midway through Calvar'ion's first phase.
They must be defeated to continue the fight.
For more information on fighting Calvar'ion, see Vet'ion/Strategies.

variantInfo.name: Greater Skeleton Hellhound (Calvar'ion)
notes: Two are summoned midway through Calvar'ion's second phase.
They must be defeated to continue the fight.
For more information on fighting Calvar'ion, see Vet'ion/Strategies.

variantInfo.name: Cerberus
notes: Boss variant, requires 91 Slayer to be fought.
Can be attempted at 86 Slayer with a wild pie boost.
For more information on killing Cerberus, see Cerberus/Strategies.

locationComparison.name: Buccaneers' Laboratory
notes: Requires 76 Sailing to access the Island.
The Rowboat can be used to travel to Buccaneers' Haven from Pirates' Cove.
Since this area is multi-combat, players can place and use a dwarf multicannon.

locationComparison.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: Killing Hellhounds here gives access to Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces as bonus drops.
No cannon is allowed, but the area is multicombat and supports relative AFK training.
After aggression expires, run south and up the vine to the Giants' Den to reset aggression.

locationComparison.name: Charred Dungeon
notes: Requires 60 Sailing to access.
Discouraged due to few spawns.

locationComparison.name: God Wars Dungeon
notes: Hellhounds are considered Zamorak followers.
It is recommended to wear God-aligned items to avoid getting attacked by multiple monsters.
Highly discouraged due to generally far and sparse spawns.

locationComparison.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
notes: Players who have not completed the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary must wear boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots.
The boots protect from the extreme heat of the dungeon floor.
Hellhounds can be safespotted near the Hellhound section entrance.

locationComparison.name: Stronghold Slayer Dungeon
notes: Stronghold Slayer Dungeon is the primary general Slayer location outside the Wilderness.
Contains four rooms of three or four Hellhounds.
A dwarf multicannon can be set up in their caves.

locationComparison.name: Taverley Dungeon
notes: 80 Agility is highly recommended and boostable at 75 with a summer pie.
Hellhounds can be safespotted on rocks and columns.
Contains multiple lower-section safespots.

locationComparison.name: Witchaven Dungeon
notes: Long distance from a bank or convenient teleport makes it less recommended than other dungeons.
A short puzzle is required to access the Hellhounds area for the first time.
Has a safespot near the entrance of the Hellhound area.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness near Resource Area
notes: High danger of player killing due to high traffic and high Wilderness level.
The Edgeville lever provides easy access to the Edgeville bank.
Area is level 49-55 Wilderness near the Resource Area.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: Multicombat area in the Wilderness.
Fast experience if using Wilderness weapons.
Popular player killing hotspot, even though the Hellhounds are below level 20 Wilderness.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness near Vet'ion
notes: Vet'ion summons two Skeleton Hellhounds and two Greater Skeleton Hellhounds during the fight.
Highly discouraged due to the area being a common hotspot for player killing.
The Hellhound spawns have no drops other than the looting bag.

taskNotes: Hellhounds can be assigned as a Slayer task at 75 combat level by various Slayer masters.
Regular Hellhounds only attack with fairly accurate melee bites, so safespotting or Protect from Melee is recommended.
Hellhounds are primarily known for hard clue scrolls at 1/64, or 1/32 in the Wilderness with an imbued ring of wealth.
They also drop ensouled hellhound heads and the smouldering stone.
Hellhound monster page marks them as demonic creatures, so demonbane weapons work against them.
Level 122 and level 136 Hellhounds have a 50% water weakness and virtually nonexistent magic defence.
Outside the Wilderness, Hellhounds are primarily killed in the Stronghold Slayer Cave because there are four rooms of three or four Hellhounds and a dwarf multicannon can be set up.
Catacombs of Kourend Hellhounds are used for Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.
The Catacombs do not allow a cannon but are multicombat and allow relative AFK training, especially with a Venator Bow.
After Catacombs aggression expires, players can run south and up the vine to the Giants' Den to reset aggression.
In the Wilderness, Hellhounds are primarily killed in the Wilderness Slayer Cave by Krystilia task users.
Wilderness Slayer Cave Hellhounds have a 50% increased smouldering stone drop rate and access to the Wilderness Slayer Cave drop table.
The Wilderness Slayer Cave is a popular player killing hotspot and players should not bring items they are unwilling to lose.
Revenant hellhounds do not count towards a normal Hellhound task and only count for Revenants tasks assigned by Krystilia.
The Skeleton Hellhound fought during In Search of the Myreque counts towards a Hellhound Slayer task during the quest, but its Nightmare Zone refight does not.
Bouncer fought during Fight Arena counts towards a Hellhound Slayer task during the quest, but its Nightmare Zone refight does not.
Bouncer's ghost fought during The General's Shadow does not count toward Hellhound Slayer tasks and cannot be fought after completing the miniquest.
Skeleton Hellhounds summoned by Calvar'ion and Vet'ion can progress the task and each boss kill spawns four Hellhounds total.
Calvar'ion and Vet'ion are player killing hotspots and players should not bring items they are unwilling to lose.
Cerberus is an alternative for players with 91 Slayer or 86 Slayer with a wild pie boost.
Cerberus is stronger than other Hellhounds, has additional mechanics, and can drop valuable uniques.
Cerberus is recommended only with Ward of Arceuus and either Arclight, Emberlight, or Scythe of Vitur because worse setups may use too many prayer potions.
recommendedMethod: Use Protect from Melee with demonbane melee in Stronghold Slayer Cave for cannon tasks, Catacombs with Venator bow for AFK shards/totems, or Wilderness Slayer Cave only when accepting player killing risk.
